stories.title: "La injerencia no resuelve los problemas y provoca violencia", afirma Sheinbaum desde Culiacán; reitera apoyo a gobernadora interina

en.title: "Interference does not solve problems and causes violence," Sheinbaum says from Culiacán; reiterates support for interim governor
en.summary: Mexican President Sheinbaum stated in Culiacán that interference does not resolve issues and generates violence, while reaffirming her backing for the interim governor.

stories.title: Zelenski anuncia reunión con Trump tras ataque contra Rusia; asegura que hay "ideas para desescalar"

en.title: Zelenski announces meeting with Trump after attack against Russia; assures that there are "ideas to de-escalate"
en.summary: Ukraine's president announced plans to meet with Trump following a major Ukrainian drone and missile attack on Russian territory, indicating potential proposals for reducing tensions.

stories.title: Cruz Azul se roba los mejores MEMES al perder con Monterrey por un error de Kevin Mier

en.title: Cruz Azul steals the best MEMES by losing to Monterrey due to Kevin Mier's error
en.summary: Cruz Azul suffered a painful defeat against Monterrey at the BBVA stadium, with the match decided by a goal from César Garza following a goalkeeper mistake.

stories.title: Partido de Putin se perfila ganador de elecciones en Rusia con 49.4% de los votos

en.title: Putin's party is shaping up as winner of Russian elections with 49.4% of votes
en.summary: A state polling firm gave Russia's United party 49.4% support in Russian elections, with voting occurring amid a massive drone attack.

stories.title: Injerencia extranjera genera violencia, dice CSP en Culiacán

en.title: Foreign interference generates violence, says CSP in Culiacán
en.summary: During a visit to Culiacán, Mexico's leadership stated that foreign interference causes violence and emphasized that Mexico determines Sinaloa's future.

stories.title: Zelenski anuncia reunión con Trump en Nueva York: “Podría cambiar muchas cosas”

en.title: Zelenski announces meeting with Trump in New York: "It could change many things"
en.summary: Ukraine's president announced a planned meeting with the U.S. president following a telephone conversation, though he did not specify when it would take place.

stories.title: Secretaría Anticorrupción analiza exposición de datos de clientes de Aeroméxico

en.title: Anti-Corruption Secretariat analyzes Aeroméxico customer data exposure
en.summary: Aeroméxico launched an investigation into a data exposure incident. The airline stated it has not identified financial information at risk.

stories.title: Mourinho raja contra el arbitraje del Derbi entre Atlético y Real Madrid

en.title: Mourinho criticizes refereeing in Atlético-Real Madrid Derby
en.summary: The Real Madrid coach expressed his displeasure with refereeing decisions made during the match, specifically regarding a play involving Kang-in Lee and Valverde.

stories.title: Alejandra Guzmán, de buen humor, luego de que le acomodaran la cadera: "ten cuidado con el corazón, con el titanio y todo lo demás", canta

en.title: Alejandra Guzmán, in good spirits after having her hip adjusted: "be careful with the heart, with the titanium and everything else", she sings
en.summary: Mexican singer Alejandra Guzmán experienced a hip dislocation during a concert performance but appeared in good humor after receiving medical treatment for the injury.

stories.title: Anticorrupción detecta presunta filtración de base de datos de Aeroméxico; advierte venta de 15 millones de registros

en.title: Anticorruption detects alleged data breach of Aeroméxico database; warns of sale of 15 million records
en.summary: An anti-corruption agency discovered evidence that approximately 15 million customer records from airline Aeroméxico were being offered for sale online.

stories.title: Indaga SABG venta de datos de clientes de Aeroméxico

en.title: SABG investigates sale of Aeroméxico customer data
en.summary: Mexico's anticorruption secretariat identified that 15 million passenger records from Aeroméxico were being sold on the messaging platform Telegram.

stories.title: Miguel Borja salva al América de caer derrotado durante el clásico ante Chivas

en.title: Miguel Borja saves América from defeat during the classic against Chivas
en.summary: América, managed by Uruguayan coach Guillermo Almada, remains in third place with 17 points and one pending match after a match against Chivas.

stories.title: Trump no tolerará los intentos de frenar el desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Trump will not tolerate attempts to slow AI development
en.summary: The president rejects growing societal skepticism toward artificial intelligence, which has been fueled by warnings about potential dangers to humanity.

stories.title: Planes Premium de Disney+ “puede incluir anuncios”, pero no es tan malo como parece

en.title: Disney+ Premium plans "may include ads," but it's not as bad as it seems
en.summary: The streaming platform faces user complaints about increasingly restrictive measures being implemented on its service.

stories.title: 10 millones de dispositivos y menos de cinco segundos, la carrera de SkyAlert ante un sismo

en.title: 10 million devices and less than five seconds, SkyAlert's race against an earthquake
en.summary: SkyAlert's earthquake alert system uses sensors, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to detect earthquakes and distribute alerts to millions of devices in seconds. The technology analyzes potential impact before sending notifications.

stories.title: Registro telefónico llega a 54.7%, mientras las fallas en plataformas aún complican la vinculación

en.title: Telephone Registration Reaches 54.7%, While Platform Failures Continue to Complicate Linking
en.summary: More than half of active telephone lines are now registered, but technical issues with platforms persist in hindering users from completing the linking process.
